empty.title: Pick a site to start
empty.body: Choose a saved site in the sidebar, or use quick connect to try a server.

trust.title: Trust this server?
trust.body: This server key is new. Check the fingerprint before trusting it.

changedKey.title: The server key is not the one you trusted
changedKey.body: Someone could be pretending to be this server. Compare the new fingerprint with the one your server administrator gave you before deciding.
changedKey.help: Add it if the service has several servers behind one name, each with its own key. Replace the trusted keys if the server's key really changed. Cancel if you are not sure.

errors.host_key_changed: The server key changed since it was trusted. This could be an attack: do not connect.
errors.remote_permission_denied: You do not have permission to read this folder.
errors.not_a_directory: This path is not a folder.
errors.path_exists: An item with this name already exists.
errors.destination_blocked: This address is not allowed by the server policy.
errors.host_unresolvable: The host name could not be resolved.
errors.vault_locked: Unlock the vault to use the saved credentials.
errors.quick_connection_not_found: This quick connection was closed. Open it again from quick connect.
errors.nameInvalid: The name cannot contain a slash or be . or ..
errors.tree_too_large: This folder is too big to copy or archive: it holds too many items or goes too deep.
errors.time_zone_inconclusive: The times of the server do not match the clock, so no time zone fits.
errors.credentials_required: This site asks for its password when connecting.

delete.body: {{name}} will be removed from the server. This cannot be undone.

upload.dropHint: Drop files to upload them here
upload.failures: Some files could not be uploaded
upload.conflictBody: Overwrite the file on the server with the one you chose?

connecting.title: Connecting to {{name}}…
connecting.hint: Opening the connection and reading the first folder

split.compare: Compare and sync with the other pane

copy.dropHint: Drop here to copy the file

local.hint: Pick a folder of this computer to browse it here and drag files to and from your servers.
local.unsupported: This browser cannot open folders of your computer. Use Chrome, Edge or another Chromium browser.
local.failure: The file could not be saved
local.readFailure: The folder could not be read.
local.dropHint: Drop here to save the file in this folder
local.saveFailures: Some files could not be saved

archive.failure: The files could not be downloaded
archive.tooMany: This folder holds more than {{limit}} files. Download it as a ZIP instead.

policy.title: Copy {{name}}
policy.body: Choose what happens to files that already exist in the destination folder.
policy.label: If a file exists
policy.newer: Overwrite only if the source is newer
policy.verifyHint: Reads every copied file back and compares it with the bytes that were sent. It takes longer.

checksum.failed: The checksum could not be computed.

timezone.button: Detect the time zone of the server
timezone.working: Writing a small file to read its time…
timezone.exact: This server lists exact times in UTC. No time zone is needed.
timezone.offset: The server prints times {{offset}} from UTC.
timezone.manual: Choose the time zone in the settings of the site.
timezone.quick: Save this connection as a site to keep the time zone.
timezone.failed: The time zone could not be detected.
timezone.inconclusive: The times of the server do not match the clock, so no time zone fits.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Looks for files and folders below {{path}}, and everything inside them.
search.hint: Plain text matches anywhere in the name. A pattern with * or ? matches the whole name.
search.truncated: There is more; narrow the search to see everything.

log.title: Log
log.empty: The steps of the connection show here.

connecting.jump: Connecting to {{host}}:{{port}} through the jump host…

host_key_unknown.key: The server key is not trusted yet: {{keyType}} {{fingerprint}}. Confirm it to go on.
host_key_unknown.certificate: The server certificate is not trusted yet: {{fingerprint}}. Confirm it to go on.

host_key_changed.key: The server key changed: {{keyType}} {{fingerprint}}. The connection was refused.
host_key_changed.certificate: The server certificate changed: {{fingerprint}}. The connection was refused.

steps.plain_text: The server offers no TLS: going on in clear text, the password included.

disconnected.title: Disconnected from {{name}}
disconnected.body: Nothing is open to this server. Connect again to browse it.
